_comment: Committed baseline for benchmarks/check_regression.py (T3). Generated by running the 'ci_guard' cell (benchmarks/run_benchmarks.py) six times back-to-back as separate subprocesses on the development machine below, and taking the median of those six run-phase medians. The observed run-to-run spread across those six independent runs was 3.85% of the median -- see 'observed_spread_pct'. This is a *local* spread on quiet hardware; CI runners are shared and noisier, which is why check_regression.py's factor (see its docstring) is far looser than 3.85%.
